linkedin.text:
🚨 Your AI agent can write code, debug APIs, and analyze data — but it still can't create a simple PowerPoint.

Why? Because document automation is stuck in 2010. Fifty lines of Python, three different libraries, zero visual feedback, and your agent is flying blind.

🛠️ OfficeCLI fixes this in one command:

✅ Single binary — no Office install, no runtime dependencies
✅ Built-in HTML renderer — agents can see their edits live
✅ Full CRUD on Word, Excel, PowerPoint — create, read, modify, reorganize

What used to take a custom Python pipeline now takes:

```bash
officecli add deck.pptx / --type slide --prop title="Q4 Report"
```

That's it. Your agent just created a slide.

⭐ 3,500+ stars. Built by developers who got tired of wrestling with python-pptx in production.

🚀 Search GitHub for **OfficeCLI** and clone the repo.

Question: What's the gnarliest document-generation problem you've had to solve with code?
